meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把视频里的配乐与旁白混合好,做淡入淡出、音量自动压低与音效处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里的背景音乐盖住了人声,想快速把两条音轨混好。
copy.tagline_en: Mix music and voiceover in your video with fades, ducking, and track effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if background music drowns out the voiceover and you need them balanced.

howto.what: 当 HyperFrames 合成里已放好音频,Claude 会为这些轨道做混音:淡入淡出、交叉淡化、增益与音量自动化、人声 carve、效果链和 submix 总线,并把设置写进元素的属性;预览与渲染共用一套实现。
howto.when: 当合成里已放好音频、需要混音时触发:淡入淡出、音量自动化、ducking 等;它不负责找或生成音频(那是 /media-use),也不管片段时序与轨道布局(/hyperframes-core)。

say.text: 给旁白做 voiceover carve,让音乐床只让出人声占用的频段
say.note: 床保留低频和高频,不做整体压低

say.text: 给这条人声轨加一个 80 Hz 高通,去掉低频轰隆声
在这条音轨上画一条音量自动化包络,开头 2 秒淡入
say.note: 生成一条音量自动化 lane

howto.what_en: With audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition, Claude mixes those tracks: fades, crossfades, gain and volume automation, voiceover carve, effect chains, submix buses. It writes settings to element attributes; preview and render share one implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio already placed in a composition needs mixing: fades, volume automation, ducking and more. Not for sourcing or generating audio (/media-use) or clip timing (/hyperframes-core).

say_en.text: Carve the voiceover: make the music bed give up only the bands the voice uses
say_en.note: Bed keeps its low end and top.

say_en.text: Add an 80 Hz highpass on this voice track to remove rumble
Draw a volume automation envelope that fades this track in over 2 seconds
